title: qPCR sample transfer from 96-well to 384-well plates
author: Opentrons
materials: This protocol builds a 384 well plate with from up to 14 columns from up to 2 96 well plates. It is a pythonization of [this protocol](https://s3.amazonaws.com/pf-upload-01/u-4256/0/2020-07-17/uo03r2t/Covid-19%2012%20columns%20.json), which only could not run a variable number of columns. This protocol is used for building qPCR plates. --- * [8-Channel Electronic Pipette (GEN2) P20](https://shop.opentrons.com/collections/ot-2-robot/products/8-channel-electronic-pipette) * [Opentrons 20uL Filter Tips](https://shop.opentrons.com/products/opentrons-20ul-filter-tips) * [Hard-Shell 384-Well PCR Plates, thin wall, skirted, clear/white #HSP3805](https://www.bio-rad.com/en-us/sku/hsp3805-hard-shell-384-well-pcr-plates-thin-wall-skirted-clear-white?ID=hsp3805) * [NEST 96 Deepwell Plate 2mL](http://www.cell-nest.com/page94?product_id=101&_l=en)
Download protocol with desired number of columns

steps.title: Download protocol file
steps.instruction: Download the Python protocol file that specifies the desired number of columns (up to 14) for the 384‑well plate.

steps.title: Gather consumables and equipment
steps.instruction: Collect all required items: an 8‑Channel Electronic Pipette (GEN2) P20, Opentrons 20 µL filter tip rack, Hard‑Shell 384‑Well PCR plates (thin wall, skirted, clear/white, catalog #HSP3805), and up to two NEST 96 Deepwell plates (2 mL).

steps.title: Load plates onto robot and replace tips
steps.instruction: Place the 96‑well deepwell plate(s) and the 384‑well PCR plate onto the robot deck, load the 20 µL filter tip rack, and replace all tips with fresh tips.

substeps.instruction: Set the NEST 96 Deepwell plate(s) (maximum two) in the designated deck slots.
Place the Hard‑Shell 384‑well PCR plate in its slot.
Load the Opentrons 20 µL filter tip rack onto the deck.
Use the robot to replace all tips with fresh tips.

steps.title: Run the transfer protocol
steps.instruction: Execute the downloaded protocol on the robot to transfer samples from the up to two 96‑well plates into the 384‑well plate, filling up to 14 columns as specified.
